messages:
Maya (sales): Hey @Ben — quick kickoff for the Neonbridge migration POC. Customer wants drop-in parity from CompetitorX for the /generateText and /extract endpoints. Can you confirm acceptance criteria?
Ben - Neonbridge: Hi Maya — main asks: 1) same response shape for /extract (we rely on 'entities' array), 2) match top-3 completions for short prompts, 3) no auth changes for dev-test (we'll validate prod SSO later).
Ravi (solutions): Noted. For parity we'll provide a light proxy that maps CompetitorX headers to Redwood calls. Rough mapping sample: 
```json
{
  "X-Client-Id": "Authorization: Bearer <token>",
  "/generateText": "/v1/generate",
  "response_map": {"choices":"outputs", "text":"content"}
}
```
Ben - Neonbridge: That mapping looks fine. Two Qs: will token accounting differ (they bill per-request, we bill per-token)? And can we preserve user-provided request_id header?
Maya (sales): Pricing note — for the POC we can offer a trial credit and fixed monthly cap. For production, we can model billing to approximate their per-request spend during the pilot. I'll follow up with numbers.
Clara (security): Quick security checkpoints: 1) What data is logged in proxy? 2) KMS support for customer-managed keys? 3) ISO/SOC2 certs needed for procurement.
Ravi (solutions): Proxy will not persist request bodies except for temporary cache keys (TTL 1h) — logs will be request-id, timestamp, latency, and model/version. We can wire KMS for envelope encryption + support BYOK (we have a KMS integration plan).
Tomas (legal): Procurement needs SOC2 attestations and a DPA template. Also need clarity around subprocessors (specifically which cloud regions will process EU PII).
Ben - Neonbridge: EU residency is mandatory for their EU customers. Also for /extract we sometimes rely on token offsets in responses — will that be stable?
Ravi (solutions): Token offset stability: different tokenizers = risk. For the adapter we can return both original offsets and a normalized UTF-16 offset when we detect mismatch. Example response shim: 
```json
{"entities":[{"text":"Acme","start_char":12,"end_char":16,"orig_token_index":5}]}
```
Ben - Neonbridge: Great. Can you also mirror the competitor's error codes? Their integration checks for 429 vs 503 behavior.
Ravi (solutions): We can emulate 429 for rate-limit in the shim and expose a header `X-Redwood-Compat: CompetitorX`. We'll document exact mapping.
deploy-bot: staging deploy started for branch `neonbridge-compat-proxy` — build 2026.3.14-87; smoke tests queued.
Clara (security): For KMS + BYOK we'll need a short architecture diagram and an audit plan. Can you add that to the POC repo? Also list of log fields (no payloads).
Ravi (solutions): Will add ARCH.md and security_checklist.md to the repo. I'll include a minimal sequence diagram and the envelope flow for keys.
Maya (sales): Timeline proposal: Week 0 — onboarding + test tokens; Week 1 — deploy proxy to staging; Week 2 — integration tests + parity checks; Week 3 — handoff and prod smoke. Ben, is that feasible for your team?
Ben - Neonbridge: Week 3 looks tight but acceptable. One blocker: procurement needs the SOC2 report before prod sign-off. Can we get an interim attestation?
Tomas (legal): We can provide SOC2 Type II report and a short subprocessor list. I'll attach the DPA draft in a private email.
Maya (sales): Action items: 1) Ravi add ARCH.md + error mapping doc; 2) Clara get audit fields list; 3) Tomas send DPA; 4) I'll share POC pricing cap by EOD.
Ravi (solutions): On it. I'll also add a small sample compat test harness — quick curl to show header mapping: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://neonbridge.internal/proxy/generateText \n  -H "X-Client-Id: client-123" \n  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize sales call"}'
```
Ben - Neonbridge: Perfect. Please make the harness produce a JSON diff output so our QA can run nightly.
deploy-bot: staging deploy completed — smoke tests passed (7/7).
Clara (security): Received ARCH.md link. One note: ensure `request_id` is never logged to public dashboards. Keep it only in audit logs with restricted access.
Maya (sales): Thanks team. I'll loop back with pricing and attach the SOC2 copy to the shared drive. :thumbsup:
Ben - Neonbridge: Thanks everyone — excited to get started.
